ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark/black) pixels comprising approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) patches covering approximately 15% concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottled regions localized at the outer margins of both the left and right lobes. Scattered circular and linear white pixel clusters (0.5% to 2% surface area) are distributed across the dark central field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing boundary characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across both lobes. The serrations are most pronounced and jagged at the extreme distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve follows a broad convex sweep from the proximal center to the distal tips, terminating in a sharp upward and outward orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-intensity pixel clusters (barnacle scars) detected across the dark field, with a higher density of such clusters on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned linear high-intensity pixel streaks observed primarily on the left lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular texture and high-contrast pixel fragmentation at the extreme tips of both lobes; numerous white circular scars distributed across the central dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'frosting' pattern where white pigmentation is strictly confined to the distal 1/5th of the total fluke width on both lobes.
